body:
Agent's bash tool could not initialize its parser with `web-tree-sitter@0.27.0` because it imported the WASM filename removed in 0.26. It now resolves the current WASM export and falls back to the 0.25 export, with real parser and permission enforcement tests for both versions.

Related to #322. **The OpenTUI blocker remains, so this PR does not close #322 or lift the `0.25.10` pin.**

## Changes

- Load the renamed WASM asset while retaining the runtime currently supported by OpenTUI. Verify that an allowed command executes and denied commands in chains and command substitutions are rejected before executing.
- Add a packed-package regression script to the Ubuntu CI job. It installs temporary Agent packages with `0.25.10` and `0.27.0`, checks their peers, and runs the actual bash tool tests without AI API calls.
- Upgrade both OpenTUI packages to `0.5.13`, refresh newly released direct patches required by the freshness check, and refresh both lockfiles. Resolve the initial audit failure with patched `brace-expansion` and `ip-address` versions.
- Extend the existing patch changeset and document the upstream evidence and remaining acceptance criteria in [the investigation](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/blob/issue-322-a819429ebc4d/experiments/issue-322/README.md).

## Reproduction

Run `bun experiments/issue-322/verify-bash-parser.mjs` from the repository root. Before the change, the three functional tests passed with `0.25.10` and failed with `0.27.0`: `Cannot find module 'web-tree-sitter/tree-sitter.wasm'`. After the change, all four tests pass with both versions.

The production package installs without incorrect-peer warnings and `npm ls web-tree-sitter --all` succeeds. The experimental `0.27.0` package still reports an incorrect OpenTUI peer and `ELSPROBLEMS`; the script explicitly verifies this remaining incompatibility.

## Remaining upstream blocker

The current `@opentui/core@0.5.13` still requires the exact `web-tree-sitter@0.25.10` peer and its worker still loads the old WASM filename. The [maintainer confirmed that 0.26+ is unsupported](https://github.com/anomalyco/opentui/issues/1201#issuecomment-4806912949), and [the upstream fallback proposal](https://github.com/anomalyco/opentui/pull/1203) was closed without merging. Agent's filename adaptation cannot establish OpenTUI compatibility. Keep the direct pin and its open #322 freshness exception until an upstream release supports the current runtime and the complete packed package passes installation and worker tests.

## Validation

- `npm test`: 812 pass, 4 existing todo, 0 fail.
- Packed bash parser matrix: 4 pass with each of `0.25.10` and `0.27.0`.
- Dry-run integration suite: 20 pass, 0 fail.
- `cargo test --all-features`: 433 pass, 0 fail.
- `npm run check`, changeset validation, `bun install --frozen-lockfile`, and the dependency freshness check: pass.
- `npm audit --package-lock-only --audit-level=high`: pass; two existing low-severity Babel findings remain through OpenTUI.

All five workflows pass on the latest commit, `07f599b`: [JS CI](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/actions/runs/36702901811) (Linux, macOS, Windows, packed parser matrix, clean installation, and verbose integration), [Security](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/actions/runs/36702901747), [Dependency Freshness](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/actions/runs/36702901842), [Workflows](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/actions/runs/36702901786), and [Broken Link Checker](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/actions/runs/36702901827).

The initial [Security run](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/actions/runs/36700558729) failed on high-severity `brace-expansion` advisories (downloaded audit-job log lines 186–196, exit failure at line 212). Both refreshed lockfiles select `brace-expansion@2.1.7`/`5.0.12` and `ip-address@10.7.2`.
